Let those who have sown doubts be rebuked, for such wrongs will not stand without an answer.

passage: Short of breath and weakened by the fierce gales that besiege this roofless tower, I stand in awe at the realization that our beloved Master had been secretly constructing a folly in the very heart of the edifice, a structure of marble and granite sanctioned by his own false accounting and disregard for our sacred space. I must see him; therefore, I will descend, keeping a solemn and measured step, for such a confession calls for both courage and humility. Thus, with trembling hand balanced on gnarled oak, I shall knock with the thud of truth upon his cold, stone heart, seeking an understanding, a reparation, and a return to our pure and purposeful paths.
